name: SMTP2GO
summary: Reliable transactional and bulk email delivery. Send via a simple SMTP relay or API with strong deliverability, real-time analytics and global sending infrastructure.
best_for: businesses that want dependable transactional/bulk sending via SMTP or API with human support and clear per-volume pricing
skip_if: you're inside a marketing platform that already sends for you, or you need advanced template/campaign tooling bundled in
honest_knock: It's the pragmatic middle of email infrastructure: simpler and better-supported than the hyperscale APIs, cheaper than most, with useful reporting, but sending reputation is still yours to earn. A relay delivers what your domain deserves: without proper SPF/DKIM/DMARC and list hygiene, no provider saves you. Check the overage rate for your tier before you size up: on the 10,000 plan an extra thousand emails costs $1.20 against the $1.50 a thousand you already pay, and the 50,000 plan at $30 works out cheaper per email than Professional at $75.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-09-26 on smtp2go.com/pricing with the volume slider walked through all nine stops; the plan cards carry the amounts in their data-rate-monthly and data-rate-annual attributes; re-read 2026-11-17 from the plan data embedded in the same page, every amount and overage rate unchanged) Free: 1,000 emails a month, 200 a day, 5 days of reporting, ticket support only (toll-free phone and live chat limited to 14 days), extra emails not permitted. Starter: $15/mo or $150/year for 10,000 (overage $1.20 per thousand); $30/mo or $300/year for 50,000 ($1 per thousand). Professional: $75/$750 for 100,000 ($0.85), $170/$1,700 for 250,000 ($0.70), $280/$2,800 for 500,000 ($0.60), $520/$5,200 for 1,000,000 ($0.50), and it adds a dedicated IP address and email-testing tools. Premier: custom, over 3,000,000 a month. Annual is exactly ten months' money at every step (their 'two months free'). All invoices are billed in US dollars; EUR, GBP, AUD and NZD are shown as approximations. 30-day money-back promise.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested SMTP2GO on a Free account that we created. A Verified Sender was set up by a link in a mail, without DNS; one API key was made and one test mail was sent through the API at 08:06:16. The report showed Processed at 08:06:18 and Delivered at 08:06:27, 11 seconds after the curl, to our own mailbox only. The dashboard showed 1/1.000 emails for the month and no daily maximum; the 200 a day is on the pricing page only. The prices in the app and on the pricing page match our dossier, and the card step sits behind Proceed to Checkout, which was not clicked. Cancelling was not tried: the free plan costs nothing and the link Close your account opens a survey page. Account and start: we created and activated the account (EU region), so the sign-up does not count in the times, and our AI assistant ran the test in its own tab of our browser. The dashboard was opened at 08:04 on 19 November 2026; the interface was already in English. The test plan was Free (1.000 emails/month). The dossier name is SMTP2GO and the review is on OSM (osm/smtp2go-review.html). First screen: a banner Before you can send emails, you'll need to add a Verified Sender to your account. and a setup list Almost there! Complete your account setup (25% complete). The dashboard showed 0/1.000 EMAILS SENT THIS BILLING MONTH. RESETS ON DECEMBER 19TH. A daily maximum of 200 is not shown in the dashboard. Core action: (1) Sending, Verified Senders, Single Sender Emails, Add single sender email, with a sender address of ours, no DNS and no domain check; the screen said 5 of 5 verified senders remaining on the free plan. (2) The confirmation mail arrived at 08:04 (subject [SMTP2GO] Please verify your email address for sending); its link opened Your email is now a Verified Sender. (3) Sending, API Keys, Add API Key with the description hands-on test and only the default permission (the dialog says Your API key has only one permission enabled: /email/send); the message Successfully added API Key followed. (4) A curl POST to the send endpoint of the API at 08:06:16, sender and recipient our own mailbox, subject SMTP2GO hands-on test 19 Nov 2026; the answer said "succeeded":1,"failed":0. (5) Reports, Activity showed Processed at 8:06:18 AM and Delivered at 8:06:27 AM, Email Activity (1 total) after a refresh; the log keeps Last 5 Days. (6) The message was in the inbox of our own mailbox. Time: from the dashboard opening at 08:04 to Delivered at 08:06:27 it took a little over 2 minutes, of which a short minute was waiting for the confirmation mail and reading, and about 12 clicks and entries. From the curl to Delivered: 11 seconds. The dashboard then showed 1/1.000 emails, 0,00% bounce rate and 0,00% spam rate. Plans up to the payment: Read by the tester on 19 Nov 2026 in the app (Account, Change Plan, monthly, in USD, with a switch Annual (save 17%)) and on the public pricing page smtp2go.com/pricing. Free Plan: 1.000 emails/month, 5 days of reporting, extra emails not permitted, Limited to 200 emails/day. Starter: 10.000 emails/month at $15.00/mo (+ $1.20 per thousand extra emails) and 50.000 at $30.00/mo (+ $1.00); the page shows Starter $15/mo for 10,000 emails and 30 days of email reporting. Professional: 100.000 at $75.00/mo (+ $0.85 per thousand extra emails, 1 free dedicated IP address included), then 250.000 at $170.00/mo, 500.000 at $280.00/mo and 1.000.000 at $520.00/mo. These are the amounts of the dossier (re-verified 17 Nov 2026), so the prices did not change; both Starter steps, $15 for 10.000 and $30 for 50.000, are already in the dossier. The footnote *Limited to 14 days for the free plan. sits behind Toll-Free Phone* and Live Chat* in the list of help options, so phone and live chat last 14 days on the free plan and tickets remain. The page promises Our Promise: If you don't love us within 30 days, we'll give you a full refund., and Sign Up Free says No credit card required. Checkout: the card step was not reached. In Change Plan the summary showed Free Plan $0.00/mo and Total $0.00 with Proceed to Checkout; it was not clicked, and the card would come only there. No tax, total or card field was seen. Cancelling: no cancelling is needed because the free plan costs nothing. Account, Change Plan has a link Close your account at the bottom; it opens a survey page We're sad to see you go... with reasons (Missing features I need, Switching to another product, Too expensive, Technical issues). It was not clicked through and nothing was confirmed. Not tested: domain verification and DNS (on purpose), an SMTP connection with a test script (only the API was used), a dedicated IP (only seen on the plan cards), a real bounce or spam complaint (only 0,00% bounce rate and 0,00% spam rate were seen), delivery to Gmail or Outlook (only our own mailbox), a paid plan and the card step. Clean up: the API key hands-on test was deleted with one click (the message Successfully deleted API Key, and the list says You currently don't have any API Keys.); the sender address stays as a Verified Sender (needed, no cost); the account and the one test message stay; our own tab was closed and our other tabs were not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Before you can send anything you need a Verified Sender, and the confirmation mail has to arrive first. The dashboard shows the monthly limit but not the daily maximum of 200, which is only on the pricing page. The footnote of 14 days on the free plan sits behind phone and live chat in a list of help options, which is easy to read as a limit on everything. The full API key is hidden behind a Copy button.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested SMTP2GO on a Free account that we created. A Verified Sender was set up by a link in a mail, without DNS; one API key was made and one test mail was sent through the API at 08:06:16. The report showed Processed at 08:06:18 and Delivered at 08:06:27, 11 seconds after the curl, to our own mailbox only. The dashboard showed 1/1.000 emails for the month and no daily maximum; the 200 a day is on the pricing page only. The prices in the app and on the pricing page match our dossier, and the card step sits behind Proceed to Checkout, which was not clicked. Cancelling was not tried: the free plan costs nothing and the link Close your account opens a survey page. Account and start: we created and activated the account (EU region), so the sign-up does not count in the times, and our AI assistant ran the test in its own tab of our browser. The dashboard was opened at 08:04 on 19 November 2026; the interface was already in English. The test plan was Free (1.000 emails/month). The dossier name is SMTP2GO and the review is on OSM (osm/smtp2go-review.html). First screen: a banner Before you can send emails, you'll need to add a Verified Sender to your account. and a setup list Almost there! Complete your account setup (25% complete). The dashboard showed 0/1.000 EMAILS SENT THIS BILLING MONTH. RESETS ON DECEMBER 19TH. A daily maximum of 200 is not shown in the dashboard. Core action: (1) Sending, Verified Senders, Single Sender Emails, Add single sender email, with a sender address of ours, no DNS and no domain check; the screen said 5 of 5 verified senders remaining on the free plan. (2) The confirmation mail arrived at 08:04 (subject [SMTP2GO] Please verify your email address for sending); its link opened Your email is now a Verified Sender. (3) Sending, API Keys, Add API Key with the description hands-on test and only the default permission (the dialog says Your API key has only one permission enabled: /email/send); the message Successfully added API Key followed. (4) A curl POST to the send endpoint of the API at 08:06:16, sender and recipient our own mailbox, subject SMTP2GO hands-on test 19 Nov 2026; the answer said "succeeded":1,"failed":0. (5) Reports, Activity showed Processed at 8:06:18 AM and Delivered at 8:06:27 AM, Email Activity (1 total) after a refresh; the log keeps Last 5 Days. (6) The message was in the inbox of our own mailbox. Time: from the dashboard opening at 08:04 to Delivered at 08:06:27 it took a little over 2 minutes, of which a short minute was waiting for the confirmation mail and reading, and about 12 clicks and entries. From the curl to Delivered: 11 seconds. The dashboard then showed 1/1.000 emails, 0,00% bounce rate and 0,00% spam rate. Plans up to the payment: Read by the tester on 19 Nov 2026 in the app (Account, Change Plan, monthly, in USD, with a switch Annual (save 17%)) and on the public pricing page smtp2go.com/pricing. Free Plan: 1.000 emails/month, 5 days of reporting, extra emails not permitted, Limited to 200 emails/day. Starter: 10.000 emails/month at $15.00/mo (+ $1.20 per thousand extra emails) and 50.000 at $30.00/mo (+ $1.00); the page shows Starter $15/mo for 10,000 emails and 30 days of email reporting. Professional: 100.000 at $75.00/mo (+ $0.85 per thousand extra emails, 1 free dedicated IP address included), then 250.000 at $170.00/mo, 500.000 at $280.00/mo and 1.000.000 at $520.00/mo. These are the amounts of the dossier (re-verified 17 Nov 2026), so the prices did not change; both Starter steps, $15 for 10.000 and $30 for 50.000, are already in the dossier. The footnote *Limited to 14 days for the free plan. sits behind Toll-Free Phone* and Live Chat* in the list of help options, so phone and live chat last 14 days on the free plan and tickets remain. The page promises Our Promise: If you don't love us within 30 days, we'll give you a full refund., and Sign Up Free says No credit card required. Checkout: the card step was not reached. In Change Plan the summary showed Free Plan $0.00/mo and Total $0.00 with Proceed to Checkout; it was not clicked, and the card would come only there. No tax, total or card field was seen. Cancelling: no cancelling is needed because the free plan costs nothing. Account, Change Plan has a link Close your account at the bottom; it opens a survey page We're sad to see you go... with reasons (Missing features I need, Switching to another product, Too expensive, Technical issues). It was not clicked through and nothing was confirmed. Not tested: domain verification and DNS (on purpose), an SMTP connection with a test script (only the API was used), a dedicated IP (only seen on the plan cards), a real bounce or spam complaint (only 0,00% bounce rate and 0,00% spam rate were seen), delivery to Gmail or Outlook (only our own mailbox), a paid plan and the card step. Clean up: the API key hands-on test was deleted with one click (the message Successfully deleted API Key, and the list says You currently don't have any API Keys.); the sender address stays as a Verified Sender (needed, no cost); the account and the one test message stay; our own tab was closed and our other tabs were not touched. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Before you can send anything you need a Verified Sender, and the confirmation mail has to arrive first. The dashboard shows the monthly limit but not the daily maximum of 200, which is only on the pricing page. The footnote of 14 days on the free plan sits behind phone and live chat in a list of help options, which is easy to read as a limit on everything. The full API key is hidden behind a Copy button.
